as_told.title: Roger Leir's book: Humanitas doctors' contact with a being

plain: In the Varginha case, a 1996 episode in Brazil in which creatures are said to have been captured and taken to hospitals, two doctors are said to have described a creature and a kind of telepathic contact with it to an American researcher named Roger Leir. A UFO documentary maker named James Fox tells Michels about this on two occasions. He says Leir wrote about a meeting with the two doctors at Humanitas Hospital, and that this section is in Leir's book on the case but not in Leir's recorded tapes. If true, it would mean medical staff spoke of treating a living, non-human being.
